instructions:
A character sheet for **Dresden Files Accelerated (DFA)**, also usable for the DFRPG skills track.

The sheet is organized into five tabs:

- **Worksheet** — phase/aspect worksheet for building your character.
- **Character** — name, mantles, aspects, approaches, stress, consequences, refresh, and fate points.
- **Spells** — spell tracking.
- **Equipment** — gear and items.
- **Notes** — freeform notes.

Set your **Mantle** at the top of the Character tab (the first mantle acts as your template). Use the **Power Level** selector only if you're running the DFRPG skills track; in DFA proper, power is set by Scale and Mantle instead.

Enable **rolls** by clicking the roll buttons next to approaches and skills. See the repository README for install notes and legacy-data migration.
